```{r Reading in Data}
fia_data <- read.csv("/Data/nondecline_treeC.csv")
fia_data2 <- read.csv("/Data/non_decline_forestCstocks - non_decline_forestCstocks.csv")
```

```{r Data Cleaning}
# converted units
fia_data <- fia_data %>%
  mutate(biomass.dead.C.gm2 = 100 * biomass.Mg.ha.dead,
         biomass.live.C.gm2 = 100 * biomass.Mg.ha.live) %>%
  select(-biomass.Mg.ha.dead, -biomass.Mg.ha.live, -standingdead_C_Mg_ha, -livetree_C_Mg_ha, -BGtree_C_Mg_ha)

# removed columns that were in different units
fia_data2 <- fia_data2 %>%
  select(-dwdC.tacre, -dwdC.Mgha, -AGunderstoryC.tacre, -AGunderstoryC.Mgha, -BGunderstoryC.Mgha, -BGunderstoryC.tacre, -litterC.Mgha, -litterC.tacre)

fia <- bind_rows(fia_data, fia_data2)
```

### *How does variability in total forest carbon change along a latitudinal gradient in Alaska?*

```{r Mapping, out.width="60%"}
fia_pts <- fia %>% 
  select(LON, LAT) %>%
  mutate(lon = LON, 
         lat = LAT) %>%
  select(-LON, -LAT)

alaska_map <- map_data("world", region = "USA:Alaska")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = alaska_map,
               aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = "gray90", color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = fia_pts,
             aes(x = lon, y = lat),
             color = "red", size = 0.1) +
  xlim(-185, -125) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = "Longitude", 
       y = "Latitude", 
       title = "FIA Forest Plot Locations in Alaska, USA") + 
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr", # Top Right
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_nautical(
      fill = c("grey40", "white"),
      line_col = "grey20"
    ),
    pad_x = unit(1, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.2, "in")
  ) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r Bootstrapping SD & mean w/ latitude, out.width="80%"}
set.seed(480)

# Add latitude bands
fia_data <- fia_data %>%
  mutate(lat_band = cut(LAT, breaks = seq(54, 72, by = 1),
                        include.lowest = TRUE, dig.lab = 4))

# Get the unique bands
bands <- unique(fia_data$lat_band)

# Bootstrap SD for each band using a simple loop
results <- lapply(bands, function(band) {
  band_data <- fia_data %>% filter(lat_band == band)
  
  boot_sds <- replicate(1000, {
    band_data %>%
      slice_sample(prop = 1, replace = TRUE) %>%
      summarize(sd_tree_c = sd(total_treeC_gm2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      pull(sd_tree_c)
  })
  
  tibble(lat_band = band, resamp_sd = boot_sds)
})

# Combine into one dataframe
bootstrap_dis_sd <- bind_rows(results)
# ggplot(bootstrap_dis_sd, aes(x = resamp_sd, fill = lat_band)) +
# #  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
# #    bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
#   geom_density() +
#   labs(
#     x = "Bootstrapped SD of Carbon Stock (g/m²)",
#     title = "Bootstrap Distribution of Total Tree Carbon Standard Deviation by Latitude", 
#     fill = "Latitude Band", 
#     y = ""
#   ) +
#   theme_minimal()
```

```{r, out.width="80%"}
ggplot(bootstrap_dis_sd, aes(x = resamp_sd, fill = lat_band)) +
#  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..),
#    bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_density() + 
  labs(
    x = "Bootstrapped SD of Carbon Stock (g/m²)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Bootstrap Distribution of Carbon Variability by Latitude Band", 
    fill = "Latitude Band"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

```

```{r, out.width="80%"}

  filter(lat_band != "(59,60]") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = resamp_sd, fill = lat_band)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(

    title = "Bootstrap Distribution of Carbon Variability by Latitude Band", 
    fill = "Latitude Band", 
    subtitle = "Removed (59,60] Band"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_brewer()
```
